defects.where: Tiles 3 and 4, lower right/left of box
defects.what: Door is a flat green plate hanging off the side of the box with no hinge pin or lip; it reads as a loose card, and the open end shows an empty dark interior.
defects.fix: Hinge the door along its bottom edge with a visible 1 cm rod, add a rolled lip, and put a back wall plus a few letters inside.

defects.what: Body is almost uniform untextured green sheet metal with no rust, scratches or dents; wear is absent.
defects.fix: Add rust at the seams and the base, paint chipping at the door edge, water streaks under the flag, and a dented roof.

defects.where: Tiles 1 and 6, grey block under the box front
defects.what: Unexplained block under the box, and the box just sits on the post top with no bracket or bolts.
defects.fix: Add a 2-plank mounting shelf with two bolts, or remove the block.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a mailbox on a post but plain and toy-like.

defects.what: At sheet scale the lattice, dishes and stays are too small to verify; the red/white striping is a clean repeated pattern with no rust or grime.
defects.fix: Add rust streaks below each platform and dish bolt, and fade the red paint toward the base.

defects.where: Tile 6, guy anchor blocks and base slab
defects.what: Concrete anchors are plain boxes with the stays meeting them at a point; no turnbuckle or eye-bolt is visible.
defects.fix: Add eye-bolts and turnbuckles, and a chipped, stained concrete texture.

defects.what: Dishes look glossy-clean and uniform, some with a dark rust-brown tint, which doesn't match the others.
defects.fix: Weather every dish consistently and add visible mount brackets.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Recognisable and good as a silhouette; thin guy lines will shimmer.

defects.where: Audit: 10 floating groups; centre (0,1.11,3.2), 17 parts, lowest 0.81 m, plus six 2 cm parts at y 1.04
defects.what: The cart body and its rivets hover 0.8 m above the ground, and groups near z=-7.5 and 0.28 m up float as well (logs or rocks in the back). Tile 5 shows the cart on the rails, so this is probably cart cargo or the wheels disconnected from the body.
defects.fix: Join wheels, axles and body (axle bolts); seat the cart body on the axle frame; drop the loose pieces to ground level or bury them.

defects.where: Tiles 1 and 4, left edge of rock and the frame top
defects.what: The rock wall ends in a flat vertical cut and there is a dark gap between the roof beam and the rock; the timber frame looks pasted on the rock face.
defects.fix: Round and bevel the cut edge, and overlap the header beam into the rock by about 20 cm with soil and rock fill over it.

defects.what: Scattered logs and cut blocks are uniform in size, laid out like a random scatter with no cause, and the A-frame buffer on the rails looks flimsy.
defects.fix: Stack the logs in a pile against the wall and vary size; brace the buffer with a crossbar and ground it with stones.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Strong landmark read: rock mound, timber portal, rails, cart.

defects.where: Tiles 1, 2 and 6, back of the board
defects.what: The same knot/stain blotch repeats on almost every plank at the same relative height, and two horizontal rails cross all planks. Roof panels show bright white slits at the plank joints (tile 2, top).
defects.fix: Randomise UV offset per plank and use at least three plank textures; close the roof panel seams with overlaps and darken the ridge slit.

defects.what: Roof sits on four short brackets with visible air gaps between the roof boards and the rafters, and the posts are thin for a 3.6 m wide board and roof.
defects.fix: Rest the roof boards on rafters and add 2 diagonal braces from posts to rafters; thicken posts to about 20 cm.

defects.what: Posters are flat, clean paper with no tape corners or curl or rain stains.
defects.fix: Add pins/tape, a slight curl at one corner and water-runs down from the top.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads clearly as a covered trail board; back is dull.

defects.where: Tile 3, door; audit floating groups at y 0.35 and y 1.65, centre z 1.14
defects.what: Door pieces float: a flat plate hangs on the outer left of the building (tile 1, left edge) and the door has a gap at the top and one board sticks up above the door head on the right. Two 0.9 m plank groups are not connected to the frame.
defects.fix: Cut the door to the opening height; mount the lower and upper rails with hinges attached to the frame (add 3 hinge straps); delete the extra tall plank.

defects.what: A pale horizontal band crosses every plank at about one third of the height, and the same knots and stains repeat on every plank.
defects.fix: Remove the baked band, vary the UV per plank, and put the moisture band only on the lowest 30 cm.

defects.what: Roof overhang leaves a gap you can see sky through between wall top and roof (tile 3, tile 4 top), the interior is an empty black box with a plain seat block.
defects.fix: Add a fascia plank on top of the walls to close the gap; add a seat with a hole and lid.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as an outhouse; repeating band is visible even at distance.

defects.what: A hole in the deck where two boards are missing is clean and rectangular; broken boards have no splinter ends.
defects.fix: Break the board ends diagonally, leave a splinter, and drop a loose fragment on the ground.

defects.what: Each board uses the same nail head position and similar clean, soft bevels; boards read as 3D printed.
defects.fix: Vary nail positions, add cracks along the grain and rough the edges.

defects.what: The bottom boards project at one corner as thin slivers on the ground.
defects.fix: Seat all three bottom runners on the ground, clipping a few mm into it.

defects.what: Pale square patches repeat in identical positions across the table boards; the bench planks share the same moss blotch pattern.
defects.fix: Offset UVs per plank, and put moss only at the edges and where the seat joins the legs.

defects.what: Benches rest on the leg cross-beams with no visible bolts or notches; the leg frame and boards look merely overlapped.
defects.fix: Add 4 carriage bolts at each leg-board joint and notch the legs.

defects.what: The rusty can is a smooth cylinder and quite large for the scene.
defects.fix: Add a ragged top and a dent; shrink it by about 20%.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a picnic table; blotches look like patches.

defects.where: Audit: floating group centre y 9.05 m; tiles 1 and 4, top of the pole
defects.what: A 6 cm piece hovers with no contact (likely an insulator pin or a bolt). The transformer hangs on the side with no visible bracket or straps, and the cross-arm has no through-bolt.
defects.fix: Seat the pin on the cross-arm top; add two steel straps and a bracket around the transformer; add a through-bolt at the arm.

defects.what: The shaft is a smooth, straight, evenly dark column with small pegs; no checks, no tar, no creosote staining or lean.
defects.fix: Add vertical cracks and a darker creosote band near the ground, with a stained base and vary the diameter slightly.

defects.what: Texture shows a repeating knot at identical spacing; no wire attachments.
defects.fix: Break the knot repetition and add drooping line stubs on the insulators.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Good recognisable utility pole; fine at distance.

defects.what: The deck is a flat sheet on the ground with no abutments, piers or girders under it, and the guardrails are too small to see at the sheet scale; audit height 17 m is not visible in any tile, so the deck may hover in the game.
defects.fix: Add concrete abutments at both ends, a girder beam under the deck, and at least one pier; ensure the ground meets the deck edge.

defects.what: The deck is a flat uniform grey with no cracks, potholes, kerbs or sand, and the rail is a plain tube on thin posts with a fence-like grey colour.
defects.fix: Add an asphalt texture with cracks, a kerb, rusty rail with bolts at each post, and gravel at the edges.

defects.what: Red joint lines across the deck show up as stray markings.
defects.fix: Make these expansion joints with a gap and shadow, or remove them.

assets.read_at_game_distance: At distance reads as a flat road strip with rails; no bridge structure.

defects.where: Tiles 1, 2 and 5, back of the sign
defects.what: The back is a flat plain grey with two identical brackets and no rust, stickers or stains; it reads as untextured.
defects.fix: Add rust at the bracket bolts, grime streaks, and a manufacturer sticker.

defects.what: Yellow face has uniformly distributed blotches that look like camouflage rather than weathering.
defects.fix: Concentrate peeling at the corners and bolt holes and add bullet or stone dings.

defects.what: The black base is a small dish with the pole just inserted, no bolts, and it looks like a flower pot.
defects.fix: Add a concrete footing with soil or an anchored flange with 4 bolts.

defects.what: Stubby flat slabs protrude from the base like limbs or tongues (tile 3 right: a Y-shaped lump) and look attached rather than fallen.
defects.fix: Blend or delete the limbs; bury a few small stones with soil around them.

defects.what: A dark slot under the rock shows a hole through to the underside.
defects.fix: Close the cavity or make it a deliberate overhang with a closed back.

defects.what: The same moss blotch pattern repeats on all planar faces; the big flat facets read as low-poly.
defects.fix: Break facets with extra bevels and mix moss density with height.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a boulder; faceting visible.

defects.what: A flat tongue-shaped slab sticks out of the base and looks like a pasted block.
defects.fix: Remove it or embed it in the rock with a rounded merge.

defects.what: Large planar faces with razor-sharp edges are geometric; the top shows a pinched crease.
defects.fix: Round the edges and add chips and cracks along the faces.

defects.what: The lichen pattern is a uniform noise with a tiling look; no staining where the water runs.
defects.fix: Add vertical water streaks and moss in the base crevices.

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a boulder; lumpy but acceptable.
